install:
set -euo pipefail
[ -f "$HOME/.bashrc" ] && sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true
NODE_DIR="$HOME/.local/node24"
[ -d "$NODE_DIR/bin" ] && export PATH="$NODE_DIR/bin:$PATH"
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || [[ "$(node -v)" != v24.* ]]; then
  ARCH="$(uname -m)"
  case "$ARCH" in
    x86_64|amd64) NODE_ARCH="x64" ;;
    aarch64|arm64) NODE_ARCH="arm64" ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  OS="$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
  TARBALL="$(curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/SHASUMS256.txt | awk -v pat="-${OS}-${NODE_ARCH}[.]tar[.]xz$" '$2 ~ pat {print $2; exit}')"
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.local"
  TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
  trap 'rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"' EXIT
  curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/${TARBALL}" -o "$TMP_DIR/$TARBALL"
  tar -xJf "$TMP_DIR/$TARBALL" -C "$TMP_DIR"
  rm -rf "$NODE_DIR"
  mv "$TMP_DIR/${TARBALL%.tar.xz}" "$NODE_DIR"
  export PATH="$NODE_DIR/bin:$PATH"
fi
if [ -d "$NODE_DIR/bin" ]; then
  PATH_LINE='export PATH="$HOME/.local/node24/bin:$PATH"'
  grep -qxF "$PATH_LINE" "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || echo "$PATH_LINE" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
fi
PKG_MGR="$(node -p "require('./package.json').packageManager || 'pnpm'")"
if ! command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { [ -d "$NODE_DIR/bin" ] && [ ! -x "$NODE_DIR/bin/pnpm" ]; }; then
  npm install -g "$PKG_MGR" --no-audit --no-fund
fi
if [ -f .git-blame-ignore-revs ] && git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git config blame.ignoreRevsFile .git-blame-ignore-revs
fi
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm --filter @supporters/api db:generate
